subject.title: ignoreFileContent setting not working - file content still sent to model as context

question: Should Feishu add a supported inbound attachment-context opt-out, and what canonical config name, default, and account inheritance behavior should it use?
rationale: Honoring the reported key would add a plugin-owned config/default surface that changes context behavior, while the key is currently unparsed and undocumented.

options.title: Add a Feishu-owned opt-out
options.body: Add a documented top-level/per-account option with current media download behavior as the default and placeholder-only behavior when disabled.

options.title: Use a shared channel policy
options.body: Create or reuse one cross-channel attachment-ingestion policy if maintainers want a common config shape across plugins.

options.title: Document unsupported behavior
options.body: State that Feishu supports `mediaMaxMb` but no attachment-content ignore switch, and close the expectation as unsupported.

recommendation.title: Add a Feishu-owned opt-out
recommendation.body: Add a documented top-level/per-account option with current media download behavior as the default and placeholder-only behavior when disabled.

likelyOwner.reason: The package metadata identifies this handle as the Feishu plugin maintainer signal, which is the closest owner for a plugin-owned config policy choice.
